subdivision_of_building: The proposal only affects 152-156 High Street, there are no changes proposed to 158-162 High Street.
description: Proposed 3 storey rear extension with an additional second floor to the rear
decision_conditions: The proposed three storey rear extension, by reason of its height, bulk and massing, projection above the ridge of the original building, and the use of incongruous contemporary materials, would fail to remain subordinate and would visually compete with the host property. The development would detract from the character, appearance and significance of the locally listed building. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Policies DMHB 3 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 (2020) and the NPPF (2024).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.
